purpose: Make the V31 OBSERVED-to-Typed-Entry P0 trust boundary implementation-testable without creating a second state/truth authority. This artifact distinguishes content identity from independently witnessed admission authority and records threat/acceptance rules for the single retained successor lane.

external_method_inputs.method_donor: provenance verification relies on a defined trust boundary rather than treating caller-controlled metadata as self-authenticating

externalParameters are untrusted while builder/control-plane identity represents the trusted platform boundary; output subject identity alone does not establish who was authorized to produce the attestation

trust_boundary_law.corollary: A valid event_sha256/admission_sha256 proves deterministic identity of the supplied Entry under the retained canonicalizer; it does not prove that the Entry traversed the authorized OBSERVED admission path.
trust_boundary_law.required_independence: The positive witness must be sourced from a controller-held or canonically persisted admission record that the candidate row, observation receipt, model output and untrusted observation producer cannot choose, mint, rewrite or co-mutate during evaluation.
trust_boundary_law.no_second_authority: The witness is provenance/admission evidence only. It must reference the existing Typed Entry event/admission identities and existing deterministic/canonical state substrate; it must not become a second truth database or effect path.

implementation_constraints: Do not derive expected witness identity solely from the candidate row, observation receipt or an Entry object reconstructed from those same candidate-controlled fields.
Do not accept producer source-code identity as runtime-instance authentication; source authorization and concrete instance admission are separate gates.

If the witness is cryptographically authenticated, the signing/MAC authority must live outside the candidate-controlled producer/evaluator data path; a key available to that path collapses the independence assumption.

If the witness is canonically persisted instead of cryptographically signed, verification must query/read the authoritative persisted admission record by exact identity rather than accept a caller-supplied copy as authority.
Bind the witness to exact generation and exact admission_sha256 so a valid witness cannot be replayed across generation/admission changes.
Preserve UNKNOWN/fail-closed behavior when witness authority, persisted record, generation or identity cannot be resolved exactly.
A witness validates provenance/path traversal, not factual correctness of the observation. Truth/evidence qualification remains a separate semantic/evidence gate.
falsifier: This design should be revised if a current mandatory pre-gate path is demonstrated that already supplies an independently controlled/canonically persisted exact admission witness to every retained OBSERVED path and the state-history gate mechanically verifies it.

training_effect.reason: This is a trust-boundary method delta. P0 implementation/execution, P1 history authority, P1.5 labeler repair and corpus leakage closure remain prerequisites to positive training admission.

next_exact_action: Implement the single retained OBSERVED-to-Typed-Entry bridge so expected witness authority is read from independently controlled/canonically persisted admission state rather than candidate fields; preserve the existing forged-receipt counterexample and add coherent Entry+receipt co-mutation, caller-supplied-witness, source-valid/no-instance-witness and stale-generation tests; execute exact source repository-bound on the admitted zero-cost VPS and mint zero training/whole-system credit.
